tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ dkar gsur zhing khams kun khyab bzhugs//

dkar gsur zhing khams kun khyab ces bya ba/ dkar phye gtsang ma mar dkar gyi khu bas sbags pa snum bag can gyi khrod/ shing tog /dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ rin po che/ bdud rtsi'i phur ma sogs kyang btags nas 'dres par byas la sol me dang*/ so tog la sogs ma yin pa'i me thal 'jam po la btab/ chu gtsang kho nas bran/ rang nyid jo bo kha sar pā ṇir gsal/ skyabs sems/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ sogs lan gsum sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig dran rdzogs su// rang nyid jo bo kha sar pā ṇi'i sku// bzhengs stabs phyag g.yas mchod sbyin can gsal ba'i// mdun du rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho// sku la zhing khams rdzogs pa'i gtsug tor nas// mgrin pa yan chad dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron// de bzhin thugs kar lte ba'i bar dag la// mgon po yon tan sku smad snying rje'i mgron// pad gdan bgegs rigs lan chags gsal ba las// thugs kar yi ge drug ma'i 'od zer gyis// mchod yul mnyes byas sbyin yul sdig sgrib sbyangs// khams gsum ma lus dag pa'i zhing du gyur// oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ brgya rtsa brjod/ na mo/ bde gshegs snying pos 'gro ba yongs la khyab// sems ni rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed de// 'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu// 'di na snod min sems can gang yang med// bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha// dus la mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis na// sems can don la dgongs pa'i dkon mchog gsum// yid kyis sprul zhing bshams pa'i gnas 'di ru// rgyal ba 'khor bcas ma lus gshegs su gsol// zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mgron rigs mchog dman thams cad byon nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan bdun brjod/ du ba 'di 'dod yon gyi lha mo gzugs rdo rje ma mdzes shing lta na sdug pa/

dbyangs snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ reg bya 'jam pa/ phyag gnyis na lha'i bdud rtsi ro brgya dang ldan pa'i bum pa bsnams nas mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med par spro zhing*/ snod bcud kyi nyams grib dang rmug pa dag par byed pa'i spyi gtsug na sangs rgyas rin chen mang phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi rgyas dbul ba sel zhing*/ 'dod yon gyi longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i gter du sprul par gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥsarba tha khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ na mo/ chos sku kun tu bzang po nas drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i dgongs brda snyan brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa ma tshang med pa rnams dang*/ theg pa rim pa dgu/ mdo sgyu sems gsum/ sgrub sde bka' brgyad/ rgyud sde phyi nang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bsam yas grangs med pa la 'bul lo// bdag gi rig 'dzin gyi sdom pa dang dam tshig la nyes pa'i skyon byung ba thams cad sor chud nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten yum lnga'i rang bzhin/ nang bcud kyi sems can dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i grong khyer/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad/ mkha' spyod dang sa spyod kyi bdag po dpal ldan rdo rje phag mo/ rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ khros ma nag mo dang seng ge'i gdong can/ ku ru ku lle dang 'od zer can/ dpal dang nor rgyun ma/ bkra shis kyi lha mo brgyad/ khro gnyer can dang ri khrod ma/ yum chen mo la sogs te gsang sngags dang rigs sngags gzungs sngags kyi lha mo rnams la 'bul lo// bdag gi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad skongs nas phrin las rnam pa bzhi thogs med du 'grub pa dang*/ 'chi khar gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing lam sna dang bsun ma mdzad du gsol/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas mtshon bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis/ sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dpal la sogs phyogs bcu dang mar me mdzad dang rnam gzigs la sogs pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mchog zung dang*/ sgra gcan 'dzin la sogs nyan thos kyi dge 'dun zung bzhi ya brgyad/ rang sangs rgyas rigs gnyis/ gnas brtan chen po bcu drug 'khor dgra bcom pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// bdag gi so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba thams cad sor chud nas ngan song gsum dang mi khom pa'i gnas rigs las thar te nyan rang dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis mtshon byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun nye ba'i sras brgyad/ rdo rje snying po dang blo gros mi bzad pa la sogs bskal bzang gi sems dpa' bcu drug /chos 'phags dang rtag tu ngu la sogs byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa rnams la 'bul lo// bdag gi byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las gsungs pa'i ltung ba nyams su myong ba mtha' dag lhag med du byang nas theg pa chen po'i lam la bar chad med par gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ye shes dngalas la grub pa'i chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ lha klu yul lha gzhi bdag /'dzam bu gling dang gangs can na gnas pa'i dge bsnyen dkar phyogs skyong ba ming dang mtshan nas ma thon pa thams cad la 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ 'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su phobs/ nad mug 'khrugs rtsod sol/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag chos sgrub pa'i bar chad srung zhing yon bdag dang gnas mal mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang lha klu mi dang bram ze drang srong bden tshig grub pa'i tshogs/ gnod sbyin dzam bha la/

lhan cig skyes pa'i lha 'go ba'i lha lnga/ khyim lha dang zhing lha la sogs khar rje dbang thang bskyed pa'i lha/ 'byung ba bzhi dang ri dang nags tshal gyi lha rnams la 'bul lo// bdag gi legs pa dkar po'i phyogs thams cad bskyed pa'i sdongs grogs mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dri za'i rgyal po ljon pa rta mgo can/ glu dang gar la sred pa'i dri za rab dga'/ mi'am ci grong khyer bar snang la bcas pa'i mtshon gdon gyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang*/ lan chags sha 'khon chags pa'i rigs/ 'phrog ma ma bu lnga brgya/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang bcas pa'i tshogs la 'bul lo// gdon dang gnod pa ma mdzad/ kha rje dang dbang thang ma 'phrog /ru nga dang gdug rtsub spongs shig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khyad par du 'gro ba rigs drug /lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i snying rje'i mgron du gyur pa thams cad dang*/ dbul zhing phongs par gyur pa'i yi dwags sde tshan gnyis/ khar sang da nangs sam/ na ning gi lo zla zhag dus nas snga ma'i lus rten bor/ phyi ma'i lus rten ma rnyed/ srid pa bar ma dor nyams nga'i 'phrang la skyabs dang skyob pa med pa/ mgon dang dpung gnyen med pa/ sngon gyi bsags rgyab med pa/ dge ba'i ra mda' nyung ba/ ming bzhi 'dus pa'i phung po/ tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin/ 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang gis mnar ba/ 'khyags ltogs skom gsum gyis gdung ba/ tshe tshad la nges pa med pa/ bya sgro rlung gis btegs pa bzhin gar 'gro'i rang dbang dang bral ba'i bar do'i sems can che ge mos gtsor byas pa'i bar dor gnas pa thams cad la 'bul lo// gnas grogs longs spyod bza' btung phun sum tshogs pa dang phrad nas bag phebs par gyur cig /de ltar gyur pa'i mod la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam sel mthong nas bar do la bar do yin par ngo shes/ 'khrul snang rgyas thebs/

bla ma dang dkon mchog /yi dam dang lta ba rjes su dran te/ las ngan pa'i sgrib pa skad cig la dag nas rig pa la rang dbang thob/ bde ba can dang padma 'od la sogs pa'i zhing khams khyad par can btsan thabs su bgrod nus par shog cig /rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /dam can thugs dam bskang gyur cig /rigs drug 'dod pa tshim gyur cig /lan chags bu lon 'khor gyur cig /khams gsum dag pa'i zhing*/ srid gsum thugs rje'i mgron/ ma lus khyab pa'i zas/ chos nyid nus pa'i mthus/ 'dod yon mi zad pa'i gter la longs spyod par gyur cig /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing sogs pa'i chos sbyin dang bsngo smon kyang bya'o// rang byung rdo rjes gzhan la phan pa'i blos bkod pa'o/// /
